note: Hand-tuned ladder levels. An entry here wins over the level tools/gen_ladders.mjs generates for the same programme and level number: title, tasks ("app:id" or a bare id from the programme), weather and a note. Step totals, par and standards are recomputed from the tasks named, and tools/check_ladders.mjs validates every entry. Keep the reason in the note.

1.title: Orientation — the isolation habit
1.note: The programme teaches the bench case first: lockout, tagout and live-dead-live on a panel with nothing else going on, before the same habit is taken outdoors. The generated order put the charge point ahead of it on par time alone.
